whatToWatch.text: A defense that's been suffocating: Seattle's given up just 10 points a game and is getting after the quarterback at a 3-sack clip — one game in, sure, but that's exactly the identity you want traveling to Arizona.

Low-scoring fight, high stakes: a 40.5 total and a SEA -3.5 line say Vegas expects a grinder, and Arizona's defense (14 points allowed per game, 3 sacks per game) is no pushover. Every drive is going to matter.

Injury report worth watching: Seattle has one player out and four questionable, with Ty Okada, Nick Emmanwori and Tory Horton among the names to track. Arizona's dealing with it too — Garrett Williams and Dadrion Taylor-Demerson headline their report, with one Cardinal ruled out.

newsBlurb.text: Drew Lock takes the reins in Arizona with Sam Darnold sidelined, and nobody's sure whether the injury costs Seattle one week or three. Lock looked steady in relief against New England, where the defense flipped last year's Week 1 script and closed out a 13-10 comeback instead of coughing it up late. Now Mike Macdonald's group finds out if that formula travels on the road — and Terrion Arnold's new deal gives the secondary another piece to lean on.
